categories.distribution: Canonical Workflow implementation. Copied byte-for-byte into the payload and installed into every managed target repository.

rules.rationale: New command mirroring /record-manual-plan-review.md: ingests the MANUAL_EXTERNAL_IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEW stage of the two-stage implementation-review protocol (D-Implementation-Review-Stages, CP4).
New operator guide for the two-stage implementation-review protocol, mirroring PLAN_REVIEW_WORKFLOW.md (D-Implementation-Review-Stages, CP1).

Gains a "2.2" authoritative branch (phase guard AWAITING_LOCAL_IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEW, ledger write plus phase transition on APPROVE/REVISE); the existing "1"/"2.1" advisory branch stays byte-unchanged (D-Implementation-Review-Stages, CP4). Preserves the base release's own distribution category for this path.

Gains a "2.2" branch: no enter_applying_review_feedback call; post-fix regeneration reaches AWAITING_LOCAL_IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEW via record_bundle_generation's own version-dependent resolver (D-Implementation-Review-Stages, CP4). Preserves the base release's own distribution category for this path.

technical_approval_gate_reachable's widened entry condition (a "2.2"-only ledger check mirroring plan_approval_gate_reachable) and the version-dependent bundle-generation provenance-interval check (D-Implementation-Review-Stages, CP1/CP3).
Step 0's governing-version enumeration widened from "1"/"2.1" to include "2.2" (workflow-2.5.0); steps 1-8 still run identically for all three (D-Implementation-Review-Stages, CP4).

Post-fix bounded-fix regeneration routes back through both implementation-review stages for a "2.2" work item before /approve-review implementation is reachable again (D-Implementation-Review-Stages, CP5).

governing_workflow_version activation references widened to include the new "2.2" target; also corrects the prior claim that the "2.1" branch is inert for this repository's own work items (workflow-2.5.0 correction, LOCAL_MODEL_PLAN_REVIEW round 5) and adds an explicit any-other-version refusal branch (round-7 optional finding 2) (D-Implementation-Review-Version-Activation, CP1/CP2).

Bundle-generation-record step's target-phase reference generalized to bundle_generation_target_phase(stage, governing_workflow_version), plus an explicit any-other-governing_workflow_version refusal branch added to step 0's branch selection (round-7 optional finding 2) (D-Implementation-Review-Stages "Provenance-interval interaction", CP3).
governing_workflow_version references widened for the new "2.2" activation target (D-Implementation-Review-Version-Activation, CP1/CP2).

Step 0's legacy-adoption target corrected to always the literal "2.1", never config["default_workflow_version"] (workflow-2.5.0 correction, LOCAL_MODEL_PLAN_REVIEW round 6 optional finding 1), plus a new statement that steps 1-5 are themselves version-independent, reachable identically for "1", "2.1", or "2.2" alike (D-Implementation-Review-Stages, CP4).

Governing-version check widened from a bare "2.1" literal to TWO_STAGE_PLAN_REVIEW_VERSIONS membership ("2.1"/"2.2"), with the description: frontmatter updated to match (D-Implementation-Review-Stages, CP4).

Recovered-role committed-phase membership test widened to bundle_generation_recovered_role_legal_committed_phases(governing_workflow_version)'s three-phase "2.2" set (D-Implementation-Review-Stages "Provenance-interval interaction", CP3).
governing_workflow_version references widened for the "2.2" activation target (D-Implementation-Review-Version-Activation, CP1/CP2).

Phase-guard version enumeration widened from "1"/"2.1" to include "2.2" (workflow-2.5.0), since MILESTONE_WORKFLOW.md defines this state identically for all three (D-Implementation-Review-Stages, CP4).
governing_workflow_version references widened for the "2.2" activation target (D-Implementation-Review-Version-Activation, CP1/CP2).
The two new AWAITING_LOCAL_IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEW / AWAITING_MANUAL_EXTERNAL_IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEW states and their transition edges (D-Implementation-Review-Stages, CP1).
Cross-references to the new mirrored implementation-review protocol document (D-Implementation-Review-Stages, CP1).

D-Review-Finding-Taxonomy-and-Circuit-Breaker's advisory [substantive]/[apparatus] tagging convention and circuit-breaker signal (CP8); implementation-review-stage bundle/manifest references widened for "2.2" (CP1).
Persisted-phases/writer tables, command count and the new /record-manual-implementation-review section, widened for the "2.2" implementation-review stages (D-Implementation-Review-Stages, CP1/CP4).

D-Implementation-Review-Stages, D-Implementation-Review-Version-Activation, D-Review-Material-Lifecycle, D-Canonical-Review-Data, D-Review-Finding-Taxonomy-and-Circuit-Breaker and D-Post-v2.3.1-Backlog design-decision sections (CP1, CP6, CP7, CP8, CP9, CP10).
Persisted-phase table, phase-to-writer census, command-count and generator-mention checks updated for the two new commands and phases (D-Implementation-Review-Stages, CP2/CP3/CP4).

KNOWN_PHASES additions, the generalized version-aware activation/rollback helpers, implementation_review_stages ledger writers (record_local_implementation_review, record_manual_implementation_review), the widened technical_approval_gate_reachable, and bundle_generation_target_phase/bundle_generation_recovered_role_legal_committed_phases (D-Implementation-Review-Stages, D-Implementation-Review-Version-Activation; CP1-CP3, CP9, CP10).

TestNeverPersistedPhaseVocabulary's PERSISTED frozenset and its AST-derivation helper widened for the two new persisted phases, one of them (AWAITING_LOCAL_IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEW) reachable only through bundle_generation_target_phase's call indirection (D-Implementation-Review-Stages, CP11).

The payload's own conformance suite, updated for the new review-stage writers/gates plus CP7's generic, parametric declaration-coverage helper generalizing the bespoke per-work-item pattern (D-Implementation-Review-Stages, D-Canonical-Review-Data; CP2, CP3, CP7).
